claim_ceiling: Exploratory generative theory only; no confirmed language, sound, morpheme, POS, word meaning, plaintext, translation, author, date, or origin.

generator.BOUNDARY: render adjacent latent components as JOIN, manual SPACE, or detached completion according to register, role, and available width
generator.LINE: emit ENTRY_STATE then an ordered sequence of FIELD tuples; reset coordinate at newline
generator.MANUSCRIPT: shared construction graph plus register-conditioned renderer
generator.PAGE: choose DOMAIN and a coherent page-local CORE inventory
generator.PARAGRAPH: choose INIT or CONTINUE discourse/record state
generator.REGISTER: Currier/section/hand/layout profiles alter surface probabilities without changing the shared construction graph

historical_plausibility: A late-medieval practical compendium could mix abbreviated vernacular or learned stems, conventional carrier signs, compact tabular/caption fields, and expanded prose-like serializations. This is a document-practice analogy, not a source, region, or language identification.

AI / AII + N.speculative_value: more-explicit/higher grade tends to precede reduced/lower grade

AR.speculative_value: relation, operation, or linkage class rather than a pictured-object name

CURRIER A / B.provisional_role: two realization profiles over a shared construction graph

DAL / DAR.speculative_value: two alternative settings within one field, not necessarily left/right or source/destination

DY.speculative_value: record value is closed, standard, or resolved

OL.speculative_value: the referenced item or domain value in a compound

PAGE_ROOT_INVENTORY.speculative_value: materials, entities, operations, conditions, identifiers selected for one page

SOURCE SPACE / JOIN.speculative_value: expand adjacent modules as separate groups or contract them into one label/form

ch- / sh- / che-.speculative_value: che introduces an explicit value field; ch/sh select related carrier modes

d- / s- (bound).speculative_value: d = active/process instance; s = state/reference instance

q-.speculative_value: apply or read the enclosed form under the active record frame

t / d / s (bare line-entry).speculative_value: t = initialize/new entry; d and s = two continuation modes

one_sentence_theory: Voynichese is an abbreviation-rich technical register in which page-local natural-language-derived stems are serialized through line-bounded notation-like fields, scope/mode wrappers, state closures, and optional join/detach rendering.
semantic_layer: Cores may ultimately derive from technical lexemes; wrappers and closures are primarily conventional record functions. Exact lexical values remain unassigned.
